*Brings minisodes of ‘Eli At The Movies’ to movie theaters nationwide*


*DICK'S Sporting Goods joins as the partnership's inaugural sponsor*


**NEW YORK, NY (November 24, 2026) —** National CineMedia (NCM), the largest cinema advertising network in the United States, and Eli Manning’s Ten Till Productions today announced a new partnership designed to unite movie lovers and sports fans to celebrate cinema. Through their collaboration, NCM will air minisodes of the hit YouTube show


*Eli At The Movies* during movie theater pre-shows across NCM’s network of approximately 22,000 screens in over 1,750 theaters nationwide, celebrating the cultural intersection of sports and movies. The minisodes, drawn from a new episode of


*Eli At The Movies* now available on YouTube, will run in theaters from November 30 through December 20. Alongside the partnership, DICK'S has signed on as the inaugural sponsor of the


*Eli At The Movies* pre-show integration.


*Eli At The Movies* is a digital sports series available on YouTube, in which legendary NFL quarterback and two-time Super Bowl champion Eli Manning watches his favorite sports movies, and analyzes them with celebrity guests. Notable episodes have included Jon Hamm rewatching


*The Natural* , Peyton revisiting


*Teen Wolf,* Ben Stiller enjoying


*Meet the Parents,* and Marshawn Lynch reviewing


*Jerry Maguire.* The first sponsored episode in the partnership features Chris Pratt watching Karate Kid 1 and 2.


As partners,


*Eli At The Movies* and NCM will use their platforms to draw attention to film while connecting diverse audiences across movies, sports and pop culture.


“It’s been a lot of fun breaking down iconic sports movie scenes with friends and celebrity guests on YouTube,”


**said Eli Manning.** “Now, thanks to our partnership with NCM, moviegoers can join in the fun and relive those half-court shots, dramatic goals, and last-second, game-winning touchdowns. Or, as coaches usually call them, busted coverages.”


“We’re always looking for authentic ways to show up where sports and culture intersect, which is what makes this partnership such a great fit for DICK’S,” said


**Ryan Gallaher, VP of Category Marketing at DICK’S.** “


*Eli At The Movies* brings a fun and fresh perspective to some of the sports stories people already know and love, and we’re excited to help bring that content to fans in theaters this holiday season.”


Movie theaters are one of the last places where audiences give their full, undivided attention. Audience members in a movie theater are up to


[16 times more focused](https://3f65113f-8cd5-402b-a0e6-0b4ac313fd86.filesusr.com/ugd/20be08_ae2055b5938d41c485a81e9467aa17a8.pdf) than audiences on social and digital platforms. Through highly targeted outreach, NCM connects brands with the audiences they most want to reach, in the most impactful environment in media. This partnership with Eli Manning and Ten Till Productions brings a new dimension to that experience uniting sports fans and movie lovers on the biggest screen.


"Sports and movies are two of the most powerful cultural forces in America, and this partnership brings them to the big screen, in front of the most engaged audiences in media,"


**said Mike Rosen, Chief Revenue Officer, NCM.** "Eli Manning’s passion for movies makes this partnership a natural fit for our pre-show experience, and we’re excited to bring


*Eli At The Movies* to audiences nationwide. We're also thrilled to welcome DICK'S Sporting Goods as our inaugural sponsor, extending this partnership's reach to one of the country's leading sports and outdoor retailers."


Through driving engagement and uniting brands with diverse audiences using film and pop culture, NCM gives brands unmatched access to coveted audiences, with one out of every two 18-34 year-olds in its network. By uniting brands with audiences through film and pop culture, NCM drives engagement at scale.


**About Ten Till Productions**


Founded by Eli Manning, Ten Till Productions is a media company dedicated to creating compelling content that brings people together through stories across sports and entertainment. In addition to supporting Eli's work on the Emmy Award-winning Monday Night Football with Peyton and Eli (ESPN), Eli's Places (ESPN+), and Chad Powers (Hulu), Ten Till has also served as executive producer on Eli Manning presents The Undercovers (Amazon) and NWSL: For the Win (Amazon).


Ten Till Productions is also home to the Ten Till Brand Studio, a full-service team that connects brands with audiences in authentic, culturally relevant ways. With partners like Toyota, Jersey Mike’s, Citizens Bank, and EA Sports, the agency produces commercials, live events, digital content, and branded integrations that deliver real brand impact and audience engagement.


**About DICK’S Sporting Goods, Inc.**


DICK'S Sporting Goods creates confidence and excitement by inspiring, supporting and personally equipping all athletes to achieve their dreams. Founded in 1948 and headquartered in Pittsburgh, DICK'S is a leading omni-channel retailer and an iconic brand in sport and culture. Its banners include DICK'S Sporting Goods, Golf Galaxy, Public Lands and Going Going Gone! in addition to the experiential retail concepts DICK'S House of Sport and Golf Galaxy Performance Center. As owner and operator of the Foot Locker Business, including Foot Locker, Kids Foot Locker, Champs Sports, WSS and atmos, DICK'S serves the global sneaker community across North America, Europe, Asia and Australia, plus a licensed store presence in Europe, the Middle East and Asia. DICK'S also owns and operates GameChanger, a youth sports mobile platform for live streaming, scheduling, communications and scorekeeping.


Driven by its belief that sports have the power to change lives, DICK'S has been a longtime champion for youth sports and, together with its Foundation, has donated millions of dollars to support under-resourced teams and athletes through the Sports Matter program and other community-based initiatives. **About National CineMedia, Inc.**


National CineMedia, Inc. (NCM, NASDAQ:NCMI) is a leading premium video and digital out-of-home advertising platform in the U.S. With unparalleled reach and scale, NCM, Inc.'s national network connects advertisers, through its two brands NCM and Captivate, to hard-to-reach, young, diverse and affluent audiences utilizing the power of high attention environments, including theaters, elevators and building lobbies. A premium video, full-funnel marketing solution for advertisers, NCM, Inc. enhances advertisers’ ability to measure and drive results. NCM’s


*Noovie®* Show is presented exclusively in 38 leading national and regional theater circuits including all three national chains, AMC Entertainment Inc. (NYSE:AMC), Cinemark Holdings, Inc. (NYSE:CNK) and Regal Entertainment Group (a subsidiary of Cineworld Group PLC). NCM’s advertising platform, including Spotlight and Captivate, consists of approximately 48,000 total digital screens across theaters, office buildings and residential properties in 185 Designated Market Areas® (all of the top 100). NCM is the managing member and owner of 100% of National CineMedia, LLC (NCM LLC) and Captivate Holdings, LLC (Captivate). For more information, visit


[www.ncm.com](http://www.ncm.com/) .
